phase_status: foundation batch has stage3 implementation proof; full Phase 8-B remains open

zaion_improvements: promotion refuses packages without docs, test proof, explicit capability scope, or safety scan pass

copied_hermes_behaviors: background scheduling and proactive activity have explicit CLI controls

destructive, credential, purchase, and code-modifying autonomy is blocked at policy creation time
modules.acceptance_gate: disabled by default; enabling requires explicit cost acknowledgement and produces thought proofs.

copied_hermes_behaviors: remote agents can be listed, bound, removed, spawned, and queried through ACP-style URLs

paradigm_breakthroughs: subagents become accountable delegated principals with proof receipts instead of hidden workers
merge evidence is represented by a deterministic receipt hash tied to the delegated IO boundary
modules.acceptance_gate: delegated work records principal, scope, inputs, outputs, and merge receipt.

copied_hermes_behaviors: local filesystem actions have checkpoint and restore commands

write-before recovery becomes a verifiable action boundary rather than an informal operator habit

distillation candidates inherit identity and receipt provenance before training use
modules.acceptance_gate: trajectory export proves source turns, tool receipts, scores, and applied changes.
